newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp's FOXTEL has maiden yr loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp's FOXTEL has maiden yr loss.

text.p: FOXTEL, the Australian pay television joint venture between The News Corp Ltd and state-owned phone company Telstra Corp Ltd, said it made a A$165 million maiden pre-tax loss for the year ended June 30.
The result included launch costs and capital spending associated with the start-up of its cable service, it said.
Because FOXTEL pays Telstra for cable access as a percentage of revenue, all network costs are effectively included in the profit and loss account and no network costs have been capitalised, it said.
The total investment by both partners at June 30 was A$231 million and the number of subscribers passed 100,000 in August, FOXTEL said.
"We finished the year the number one brand in cable teelvision, the number programming line up in cable television and we are the clear cable leader," chief executive officer Mark Booth said.
"This makes FOXTEL one of the most successful cable launches in the world," he said in a statement.
